advisoryFindings.title: Add explicit preset override assertion
advisoryFindings.improvement: Extend the R6 registry metadata test to assert preset provider/metadata override resolution, not only DataSource override resolution, when duplicate preset keys are contributed by later enabled packages.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current R6 test already exercises registry loading, parent-chain validation, DataSource override behavior, and directive pre-validation, so the requirement has meaningful coverage; this would tighten coverage for one subcase.
